done_when: forge land and forge close notice when the item's forge.toml pins a different release after a worker round and run the rest of the step under the newly pinned release, saying so in one line, instead of failing on settings the old release doesn't know; a command test covers a land started on an earlier release whose worker merges an upgraded default branch, for a repo adopted on an earlier release

findings.body: When an upgraded default changes forge.toml cleanly but conflicts in a generated guide, `_merge_default` invokes `forge sync` before this handoff (src/forge/close.py:395). For a command running through the old pinned release, that subprocess still selects the old Forge, whose `check_pin` validates the entire new configuration first (src/forge/repo.py:514). An unfamiliar key such as `fast_test` therefore stops both standalone close and land's close path before `resume_pin` runs, leaving the merge unfinished. Run that conflict-resolution sync under the new pin, then complete the merge and hand off. The added close-merge cases change only forge.toml and do not exercise this path.
findings.title: [P2] Run generated-conflict sync under the changed pin

why: When a running forge land or close started under one pinned Forge release and the branch's forge.toml changes its pin mid-run (a worker merges the default branch after an upgrade), the old release keeps running and fails on the new forge.toml ('fast_test is not a forge.toml key'), stopping the item (reported by a client session on v1.2.8)
